title: Martin Nievera shares the most memorable concert of his life: ‘I sang in an empty venue with 200 people’
summary: Martin Nievera recalled one of his most memorable concerts where only 200 people attended a 3,000-seat venue, but he refused to cancel and went ahead with the full show.
